about: Starting with vision.md, the owner asked that a file's Example show the structure of the file and what goes in each section; Questions and File stay as they are; How it works shows only simple, labelled answers for a newcomer (the responsible skill, how and when the file is updated, when AI uses or updates it, where it is mentioned, related knowledge). Long lines in edit mode should wrap to the screen. The rule goes where future files and the vision skill will use it.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
